dct_title_s: India Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Jul 2023
dct_description_sm: # India Floods: Flood Proxy Maps, Jul 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these flood proxy maps for India Floods (Jul 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: New Delhi, India, Floods, 12 Jul 2023, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: Northern Haryana, India, Floods, 12 Jul 2023, v0.4** (superseded) - **EOS-RS Flood Proxy Map: New Delhi, India, Floods, 12 Jul 2023, v0.4** (superseded) **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022-2023)
